parrafos: I'm Daniel Villegas. I work as an outsourced finance director under the Delta Fractional brand.

I was an in-house finance director and finance manager at industrial, commercial, technology and public sector companies. Before that I worked nearly eight years in the securities market and in development banking.
M.Sc. in International Finance (EADA, Barcelona) and Business Administration (Pontificia Universidad Javeriana).
That experience is what I put at the service of companies that need a finance director, but not full time.
